headline: A medium-sized hippo pod: water by day, land at night, and a dominant bull who owns the river.

setting.label: Lakes, riverbanks and coasts
setting.note: Mostly in the water by day, more terrestrial at night. Males hold water territories. Rolls in mud against the sun, gathers at salt rocks and can process salt water.

playsLike: You are a medium semi-aquatic herbivore in a 'float' of up to 10 (max 5 males) led by a dominant bull who won his place in bullfights. Males patrol and hold a water territory against rival floats and other semi-aquatics. Up to 5 engage, bulls first. Against land hunters you retreat to the waterline and fight from the shallows. You flee Deinosuchus and Spinosaurus unless 5 adults are present. In the dry season you attack anything, even Apexes, that approaches your water's edge.

why.trait: Water by day, land by night
why.text: Almost exclusively in water during the day and emerges at dusk to forage inland, exactly as hippos do (official inspiration).
The dominant bull and his subordinates hold a water territory. Losing males must leave, and winners may cull calves to reset the females. Hippo bulls behave the same way.
Scales prone to overheating and sunburn, hence mud rolling. Hippos secrete their own 'sunscreen'.
In the dry season it aggresses every species approaching the water's edge, including Apexes, and fights confidently from the shallows.
Chase games, mud races, mock bullfights, and a friendly attitude to Rhamphorhynchus cleaning its scales (official inspiration: capybaras).

notLike: Hippos are giants; Lurdusaurus is Medium tier (3,200 combat weight, 600 HP) and must respect Deinosuchus and Spinosaurus.
Hippos don't have thumb spikes; Lurdusaurus stabs with them.
